summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing an irrevocable, non-discretionary share buyback programme to repurchase ordinary shares between May 26 and June 8, 2026, with a spend of £150 million. This follows a completed £350 million programme on May 22, 2026, and is part of the £2.25 billion buyback plan for 2026 announced on February 12, 2026. Shares purchased will be held in treasury, reducing capital. The programme operates under shareholders' general authority (max 169.0 million shares), with ABN AMRO managing purchases independently. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on EPS.
